name: LTX 2.3 · Extend (continue a clip, three stages)

video_extend.note: Send the end of the shot, not the whole of it: the template keeps its last $CONTEXT frames.

description: Continues a clip from its own last frames with the LTX 2.3 graph behind the keyframe preset: 360p, then x2 and x1.5 in latent space, the tail pinned again at every stage.

frames.note: Total length INCLUDING the $CONTEXT frames, which come back first. LTX wants 8n+1.

lines.text: The video continues its opening frames without a cut: the same camera move at the same speed, the same action at the same pace, the same people, lighting and style. Nothing new happens.

$CONTEXT.note: frames of the clip's tail kept as context; 8n+1 (49 = 2 s at 24 fps), no more than the clip has

$FRAMES.note: output length, context included; rounded up to 8n+1

$CHECKPOINT.note: chosen from requires.checkpoints, never by the caller

dev_fp8.note: The 3090 has no native FP8, so ComfyUI emulates the ops. That is a speed cost, not a correctness one — see the Qwen 2511 measurement for how large it can get.

models.note: The Gemma 3 encoder LTX 2.3 reads prompts with. NOT on disk on the reference machine as of 2026-09-05 (models/text_encoders/ is empty), so this preset cannot run until it is there. Declared with its hash so the bridge names the file and the folder instead of failing inside LTXAVTextEncoderLoader — and so it can verify a download rather than trust one.

compatibility.note: Measured on nothing yet. This number is inherited from the image preset and must be replaced by a real reading from the first end-to-end run.

notes: Derived from ltx-23-keyframes: same models, schedulers and steps; LTXSequencer and the guide crops replaced by LTXVImgToVideoInplace at each stage.
Renders near 1080p and is scaled back to the source's size on the way out.
The output starts with the $CONTEXT frames re-decoded; the caller drops them and keeps the rest.
Write the prompt as a description of the shot as it already is. Verbs for new events (slams, bursts, spins faster) made the model invent action the shot never had (test 2026-10-06).

sourceVideo.note: The clip to continue. Only its last $CONTEXT frames reach the model.
